### 2026-10-07 – The KiCad schematic was giving problems when trying to convert to PCB yesterday, so decided to diagnose that problem today.

**1.5h**

The KiCad schematic was giving problems when trying to convert to PCB yesterday, so decided to diagnose that problem today.

By the end of my ~1hr session yesterday, I had read through the guides and completed the KiCad schematic, but the footprint assignment and PCB conversion was spitting out tons of errors and warnings, so i messed around a bit and searched online and it turns out the footprints were giving problems- the guide didn't mention what footprints to put for what parts, and there were more parts than footprints in the folder, so I was a bit confused as to what parts needed what footprints and if some parts even needed the footprints.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/bb9e452a41111e59f2167a7145951504b40b176e1cd1fb6503f40ed925a0744d.png)

Watched a few tutorials online, and was able to fix errors for most of the parts, except the main module, the ESP. The guide called for a  XIAO-ESP32-C3 module, but the footprint had the XIAO-ESP-C6 module footprint. Still stuck on that so put it up on the #half-life channel, and moving on to the next step now, skipping over the PCB

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/29c617633f43b1e12a8265bd52115a3d101bb19f67870b421184a407af12f346.png)

### 2026-10-07 – Fixed the XIAO-ESP32 footprint problem from the last session

**0.5h**

Fixed the XIAO-ESP32 footprint problem from the last session

Found the XIAO-ESP32-C3 footprint online on github, downloaded that and assigned it to my module in KiCad. It gave me a lot of problems though, the footprint refused to be assigned to the module, then didn't work properly; thankfully though after digging around a bit i found the official XIAO-ESP32-C3-SMD.kicad_mod from Seeed, then imported it and applied it as the footprint and it finally worked

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/df81f08e7eff375e3c4827fd7b4a12990c8f9e7460d5befc6cbd56b14a5641ca.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/fd6692959278561411a2e7bbbda3001fc05757123fdf5276ccd1c013185a5fd3.png)

https://github.com/Seeed-Studio/OPL_Kicad_Library/blob/master/Seeed%20Studio%20XIAO%20Series%20Library/XIAO-ESP32-C3-SMD.kicad_mod
for the module

**0.5h**

Finally fixed the footprints problem after so long!

I searched for a long time for the correct footprints because my pcb looked different compared to the guide in terms of component appearance, (wont be counting that time though).

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/c5d177e7720789c673f0d8e144b281ca52228cb935dbe22a348069b122f897bb.png)

### 2026-10-11 – Completion

**11h**

Completion

Firstly I routed the PCB correctly, turns out my schematics were the problem in the ratsnest- my parts weren't even wired up.
So I fixed that, then routed the PCB in both layers.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/b2fa2c4b378a21560fdf569f1c6c70bedb4610fad4ad32a6ac3f3b528eee6295.png)
This did have a few issues by the way which I fixed later.
Oh and, I did change the shape to be a game controller.

I then pasted in the code from the guide into the starbie.ino after installing the libraries.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/6ba3de37a79b147ef8283e5e5412c0400ddad748d30eca1336f480c08b94a135.png)
I did change a few things to my liking.

Then I made a BOM.csv while optimizing the lowest cost, got the parts from pretty cheap but reliable listings.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/3d11fd2604981070c2a3b43c91635922468b0b62f65fba618a4d5a073d8b5073.png)

Had some money left over so I added a few quality of life upgrades like a vibration motor, a battery holder, a RGB-LED(to show mood), a buzzer, a 4-digit seven segment display, an extender for the ESP, a light sensor, and an ultrasonic sensor(for a handheld measuring device).
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/3a4cbb91ee6aaa7cc4135b90b916010dcf28b55246e81aab3f59b83788299b61.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/75a2cf54b6187d81821c535c610bf55e02da4eac070e65a0ec8bc1215e2bc422.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/63469829e71d0348cf5fbe0ebcf27fad02c56a2f8912e10341997b883c7152ba.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/1f12858e2a73a881f3960cf0b84379baef491ffa1f8f9a7527f5e4254f5ac16d.png)

Ofcourse then I had to draw up the schematics for all that stuff(it looks trash but its functional, props to my original wiring when i had just started)
The top left is all of the new stuff.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/bf737f05600732e5f290b199607696472f035e43bb9795412a51abed1876104f.png)

Then i had to rewire the PCB from scratch obviously, more components, more space and a proper layout was needed. I also learnt about vias during this when even 2 layers couldn't suffice.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RP85RpLQNGkF1woRU3LVodvnCJnZkzec/3c7ffef5f788eb341f74498270cde7a8a23dc491fc97e5aec941d65fbee69887.png)
(dunno why the components have gone transparent but eh)

And again, I had to rewrite the code because a lot of new components ofcourse, even new libraries.
